rationale_bullets: Hoover's quantitative baseline is strong and fully-proven: 76.8 PFF on 480 dropbacks at TCU 2025 (B12-earned, +6 table offset -> 82.8 adjusted - at the p75 unit reference of 81.1), with 9,629 yds / 71 TD over 31 starts - 'the most productive returning QB in FBS' (Athlon).
The named, dated tax in both books: 42 turnovers in 31 starts (P6 2026); 'a turnover issue that needs fixing' (Athlon 2026).

The situational prior is the most validated in the graded set: Cignetti's two prior transfer QBs here finished 2nd-team B10 (Rourke 2024) and Heisman/#1-pick (Mendoza 2025); Cignetti says Hoover is 'at a similar point post-spring' (P6); full OC continuity plus a Joe Moore-favorite OL.
Depth is the fragility: QB2 is FR Tyler Cherry after A.Mendoza portaled (Georgia Tech) - one injury from an unproven room.
70, M = scale twin of Utah's 2026 QB room (70): Hoover's adjusted tape is a tick below Dampier's but arrives into a stronger, fully-continuous system.
